message.content:
Below is a concise list of the long‑weekend holidays that apply to **Canada** in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, giving you a 3‑day break that includes the weekend.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1 – Jan 2** | New Year’s Day | Jan 1 is Sunday; the holiday is observed on Monday Jan 2. |
| **Feb 18 – Feb 20** | Family Day (Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Feb 20 is Monday. (Other provinces have different “Family Day” dates.) |
| **Apr 7 – Apr 9** | Good Friday | Apr 7 is Friday; the weekend is Apr 7‑9. |
| **May 20 – May 22** | Victoria Day | May 22 is Monday; the weekend is May 20‑22. |
| **Jul 1 – Jul 3** | Canada Day | Jul 1 is Saturday; the holiday is observed on Monday Jul 3. |
| **Sep 2 – Sep 4** | Labour Day | Sep 4 is Monday; the weekend is Sep 2‑4. |
| **Oct 7 – Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Oct 9 is Monday; the weekend is Oct 7‑9. |
| **Nov 9 – Nov 11** | Remembrance Day | Nov 11 is Monday; the weekend is Nov 9‑11. |
| **Dec 23 – Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Dec 25 is Monday; the weekend is Dec 23‑25. |

### Quick Reference (by month)

- **January** – New Year’s Day (Jan 1–2)
- **February** – Family Day (Feb 18–20, in most provinces)
- **April** – Good Friday (Apr 7–9)
- **May** – Victoria Day (May 20–22)
- **July** – Canada Day (Jul 1–3)
- **September** – Labour Day (Sep 2–4)
- **October** – Thanksgiving (Oct 7–9)
- **November** – Remembrance Day (Nov 9–11)
- **December** – Christmas Day (Dec 23–25)

> **Note:**  
> • Some provinces have additional holidays that create long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. George’s Day in Prince Edward Island, etc.).  
> • If a holiday falls on a weekend, the day off is usually observed on the following Monday (unless otherwise specified by provincial law).  

Feel free to integrate this table into your holiday‑planning app!
